notes.title: Version 1.10 - Major Balancing Update and new Monsters!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27758548/237ebf8d2388a5b3a3f010033410c6dac79d35ee.jpg[/img]
Dear Players!

We are happy to release our first large update of „In Vitra“, which includes some full-scale balancing improvements throughout the entire game as well as two new monsters . Beware of the inconspicuous, devious servant who has a very special bite! He’s up to no good… Also, be wary of the magma demon – a fiery fellow who really likes to hot up things! Both characters appear in the last quarter of the game adding more diversity  and difficulty to this part. In addition, we increased the overall playing time.

We hope to provide an enhanced gameplay experience for all players. Have fun! Please let us know how you like the adjustments. Your reviews help us to further improve the game!  
 
rokapublish & bumblebee.
